review_method: Selected publisher HTML passages reviewed through web retrieval. No PDF custody, image digitization, raw observations or full-paper visual review claimed.

sources.citation: Gou, Pennelly and Myers (2022), The Changing Behavior of the West Greenland Current System in a Very High-Resolution Model.
sources.reviewed_scope: Abstract; sections 1.1, 1.2 and 3.1; relevant bibliography entries.
sources.interpretation: Distinguishes shelf-break WGC from coastal WGCC and describes branching near Fylla Bank. Its discussion of flow between 61 and 64-65 degrees N cites Majumder et al. rather than supplying a measured full-current axis.
sources.source_role: Model study and secondary pointer for the proposed latitude lead

sources.citation: Majumder, Castelao and Amos (2021), Freshwater Variability and Transport in the Labrador Sea From In Situ and Satellite Observations.
sources.reviewed_scope: Abstract; sections 2.1-2.2; section 3.1 passages around Figures 4-6 and section 3.2 around Figure 7.
sources.interpretation: The 61 versus 64-65 degrees N comparison concerns different months of maximum freshening. The apparent 0.17 m/s propagation is compared with typical WGC speeds; advection and local freshwater inputs remain possible contributors. It does not identify two simultaneously occupied current-axis endpoints.
sources.width_interpretation: Coastal low-salinity bands and offshore EOF scales describe freshwater distribution, not paired velocity-defined current edges.
sources.source_role: Original salinity/transport study behind the latitude lead

rejected_inferences: Do not convert freshwater timing latitudes into a measured WGC length or connected-axis geographic floor.
Do not label freshwater-band or EOF spatial scales as current widths.
Do not promote the existing OSW Cape Farewell/Davis route gates to source-measured endpoints.
Do not combine the shelf and shelf-break current identities.

next_primary_source.citation: Myers, Donnelly and Ribergaard (2009), Structure and variability of the West Greenland Current in summer derived from 6 repeat standard sections.
next_primary_source.status: Bibliographic lead only; original full paper not reviewed for this decision.
next_primary_source.required_check: Recover actual section coordinates, current identification and compatible layer/time support before proposing a scoped latitude bound; preserve whole-current length as unresolved.
